$comment: Run-only tsconfig for scripts/admin-agent-eval.ts (plan 7.2). Modelled on tsconfig.example.json, not on tsconfig.audit.json: `@format-pack` and `@pack-extensions` are pinned to the public EXAMPLE pack (tsx never reads FORMAT_PACK, and the audit config lists the private pack first), so a maintainer checkout cannot load the private pack into a run that sends data to a model API. `server-only` maps to the no-op stub the tests use. `@/auth` maps to an eval stub: the plan stage answers its reads from the fixture world, so no guard runs and it signs nobody in; the local-stack stages install a synthetic session and a player reader on it, so the real guards run against the local `players` table. `next/cache`, the Discord sender and the social sender map to RECORDERS (src/lib/ai/admin-agent/eval/stubs/): nothing is sent or revalidated, and the grader reads what they recorded. The root tsconfig is untouched; `tsc --noEmit` does not use this file. A test (`eval/__tests__/eval-static.test.ts`) fails when this file lets a private path in.
